newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Bank stocks higher in healthy Estonia trade.
newsitem.headline: Bank stocks higher in healthy Estonia trade.

text.p: Banking sector stocks strengthened as market confidence remained strong in moderate trade on the Estonian stock exchange, dealers said.
They said that a report in newspaper Aripaev, predicting rises in several shares, sparked local small investor interest.
"Today was a another good example of the power of the local press to move the market," one trader said.
"The article forecasting the year's end index, as well as positive comments from some dealers in Aripaev certainly affected the market," he added.
The Tallinn stock exchange index gained one percent to close at 196.32 on official list turnover of 40.4 million kroons.
Hansapank was the market leader with a turnover of 12.4 million kroons of shares to close 0.50 kroons higher on 194.60.
"The trade of Hansapank stocks in Helsinki is still creating a demand and supporting the price," another trader said.
After healthy gains in Helsinki on Thursday, Hansapank added a further 0.70 markka to 74 markka.
Union Bank, also traded in Helsinki, registered turnover of 8.8 million kroons to end 1.90 kroons higher on 40.90.
Savings Bank strengthened to close 2.55 kroons up on 90.40 kroons with 8.8 million kroons of shares changing hands.
In other stocks, Forekspank firmed by 0.45 kroons to close on 146.90 with a trade of 6.4 million kroons.
Tallinna Pank continued to make small gains to close 0.05 kroons higher on 60.55 kroons on a trade of 7.0 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market was slow with a volume of only 5.8 million kroons.
Rakvere meat plant was the most traded with a turnover of two million kroons to edge higher by 0.55 kroons to close on 13.06 kroons.
Norma plastics maker was saw trade of 1.6 million kroons of shares to close on 58.00 a rise of 0.45 kroons.
